rules.description: Preserve identification-token, requisition-transcription, receipt-time, and discrepancy evidence without performing patient identification or clinical operation.

provenance.note: CMS D5203, D5309, D5313 and D5391 support evidence concepts only; the deliberately limited schema is not a complete compliant requisition.

rules.description: Validate exact field sets, synthetic tokens, true integers, real whole-second UTC, and lowered-only row/pair ceilings; reject malformed input packets explicitly.

provenance.note: Defaults, limits, field grammar, and packet rejection are invented administrative policies, not specimen rejection.

rules.description: Exclude unavailable dated evidence; choose the unique highest eligible event sequence or unknown state; preserve excluded provenance.

provenance.note: Only eligible logical records can conflict. Missing/ambiguous imported state is never assumed active or treated as provider authorization.

rules.description: Join explicit order, line, specimen, accession and metadata keys; preserve missing/orphan records and clarification references without repair.

provenance.note: Synthetic tokens and labels are compared exactly. Clarification note text never changes evidence or authorizes action.

rules.description: One specimen may serve multiple lines; each line permits one primary specimen and each specimen/line one accession. Retain competing records; collapse identical copies with raw-row provenance.

provenance.note: Aliquot, recollection, repeat testing and clinically appropriate specimen routing are not inferred.

rules.description: Check linked order/event/collection/receipt/accession chronology without inventing missing collection times.

provenance.note: Temporal checks assess administrative consistency only; recorded-before-effective events and reverse sequence histories also require review.

rules.description: Age only clean active unaccessioned pairs; compare integer seconds strictly greater than the configurable minute SLA, with equality within window.

provenance.note: The default 60-minute SLA is invented, not a CLIA requirement, stability rule, or urgency decision.

rules.description: Retain ranked reasons, isolate affected rows, emit unsent administrative drafts, and leave duplicate warnings nonblocking for clean rows.

provenance.note: Reason ranks and queue ownership are local policy. Reconciled never means accepted; packet rejection never rejects a specimen.

rules.description: Partition ledger triples and count unique eligible received specimens separately from declared order lines; expose all unmatched, excluded and duplicate evidence.

provenance.note: Dangling accession references do not inflate received-specimen or declared-line denominators.

steps.title: Load bounded mock packet
steps.procedure: Capture supplied as-of, policy and raw counts for all seven tables. Do not connect to a live system.

steps.title: Validate and isolate export copies
steps.procedure: Validate documented exact schema and hard/configured bounds. Collapse only identical objects, retain raw source locations, and reject invalid packets before business assessment.

steps.title: Resolve eligible imported state
steps.procedure: Apply each table's availability cutoff; resolve events by exact order ID and unique highest sequence. Retain unknown and cancelled states and all excluded evidence.

steps.title: Build exact ledger and unmatched register
steps.procedure: Construct the documented bounded union of receipt-order and accession-line candidate triples. Attach all eligible variants and catalog/clarification references; retain unmatched records without fuzzy repairs.

steps.title: Assess administrative contradictions
steps.procedure: Apply every identity, state, label, cardinality, missing-evidence and chronology reason in documented order. Preserve all sources; do not judge specimen suitability.

steps.title: Age clean active pairs
steps.procedure: Compute integer receipt age only for otherwise clean active unaccessioned pairs, using strict greater-than SLA. Partition triples and count received specimens and declared lines separately.

steps.title: Prepare unsent clarification drafts
steps.procedure: Create priority-sorted review drafts for rows and unmatched non-ledger records, append current clarification references without interpreting notes, and preserve duplicate warnings.

steps.title: Return bounded administrative report
steps.procedure: Return the exact shared result envelope with sorted ledger, unmatched/excluded/duplicate evidence, counts and drafts. Always state no clinical disposition and qualified review required.
